versions.summary: POST /roll-calls answers 201 when it starts a roll call.
versions.migration: Send PassBook-Version: 2026-11-20 to opt in. POST /roll-calls then returns 201, not 200. Without the header nothing changes.

versions.summary: A message or change target refuses a key it does not define, with 422 BROADCAST_UNSUPPORTED_FILTER.
versions.migration: Remove keys the target does not define (status, holderEmail, externalId, connectionId, templateId, a stray field in match or scan). The refusal applies to every client, with or without the PassBook-Version header: a dropped filter would widen a run past what was asked.
